fuse.name: OEM_SECURE_WRITE_DISABLE

fuse.name: FAST_BOOT
fuse.description: FAST_BOOT. Notes: Fast_BOOT[0] is repurposed as PCIE BAR SIZE.

fuse.name: PBL_LOG_DISABLE
fuse.description: PBL_LOG_DISABLE. 0: PBL error logging disabled. 1: PBL error logging enabled.

fuse.name: HASH_INTEGRITY_CHECK_DISABLE
fuse.description: HASH_INTEGRITY_CHECK_DISABLE. 0: Hash integrity check is enabled. 1: Hash integrity check is disabled if auth_en = 0(if auth_en=1, hash check will always be performed independent of this fuse.).

fuse.name: RAM_DUMP_USE_SN
fuse.description: RAM_DUMP_USE_SN. 0: RAM dump is tied to serial number. 1: RAM dump is not tied to serial number.

fuse.name: ENUM_TIMEOUT
fuse.description: ENUM_TIMEOUT. 0: PCIE link training timeout not enabled. 1: PCIE training timeout enabled.

fuse.name: TOTAL_ROT_NUM
fuse.description: TOTAL_ROT_NUM. 0: One root certificate available (MRC disabled) 1: Reserved. 2: Reserved. 3: Four root certificates available (MRC enabled).

fuse.name: ROT_REVOCATION
fuse.description: Root revocation list for MRC. 0: Root not revoked. 1: Root revoked. Each bit correspongs to the index of the root(ex: if the 0th index is set then 0th root is revoked).

fuse.name: ROT_ACTIVATION
fuse.description: Root actiation list for MRC. 0: Root not activated. 1: Root activated.

fuse.name: ACMT_BYPASS_DISABLE
fuse.description: ACMT_BYPASS_DISABLE. 0: When not blown PCIE ACMT should be bypassed for permission check, to enable full access to internal address space in debug mode. 1: PCIE ACMT permission check is enabled.

fuse.name: Q6SEQ_REUSED_AS_ROM_PATCH
fuse.description: 0: No reuse required by default 1:18 entry(entry index 13 to30) from Q6_SEQ region will be reused as ROM_PATCH entry .

fuse.name: ACMT_READ_BYPASS_DISABLE
fuse.description: 0: Reads from PCIE host will bypass ACMT 1: PCIE Reads will go through ACMT check.

fuse.name: PBL_LEGACY_INTX_SUPPORT_DISABLE
fuse.description: This bit should be set by PBL to remove the code related to legacy intx newly added in Waikiki PBL.
